title: 01 Brask: giant wordmark footer
strengths: One typeface (Archivo) in two weights does the whole footer: the invitation, four columns, the legal row and the cropped wordmark
The signal orange is used exactly three times (open-slot dot, 'Send it over.' block, the full stop of BRASK.), as the direction said
Studio cities with live local time in a hairline-ruled list, and copy with facts ('Twenty-two people, three cities, one long table')
slop_signals: 'Send it over.' in an orange highlight block: the highlighted-phrase move
'BOOKING SPRING 2027 · TWO SLOTS LEFT' availability line with a pulsing dot is now on every studio site
Giant cropped wordmark at the bottom is a widely shipped pattern (BAGGU, Zellerfeld, TravelPerk, Graza); competent, not distinctive
fixes: Set 'Send it over.' in orange text without the block, or keep the block and drop the orange full stop so the colour count stays at three
Tighten the empty band between the columns and the legal row; the wordmark can start higher

references.what: Giant wordmark across the bottom with addresses top-left and tiny link columns top-right; the same structure
Wordmark cropped by the bottom edge with everything else tiny; our crop follows this
'LET'S CONNECT' and an email as the one invitation above an edge-to-edge wordmark; the invitation-plus-mark idea
'MW.S' with the full stop as the only extra mark and the address in tiny type; a lesson in how little is needed
Link grid above a huge wordmark with the legal row below; the mainstream version of the pattern
